name: immobile_asset
description: An asset becomes immobile (breakdown / tow required)
seed_discipline: run under a fixed seed; cite the run ID
mechanism: calibrated incident draw (ottoq_sim_maybe_incident) with requires_tow; raise breakdown_rate profile; vehicle -> tow_requested, dispatch aborted
expected_kernel_behavior: tow_requested exits all cursors; stall it held is reconciled free; anomaly.critical_detected emitted; no assignment targets an immobile asset
